title: Top Author Contribution Delta
scenario: Find authors who contributed to the Top 10 viewed articles in two consecutive months.
tableSchema: articles (article_id INT, author_id INT), page_views (article_id INT, view_date DATE, views_count INT)
hint: Rank articles by views per month, filter top 10, then join with self on author.
correctQuery: SELECT author_id FROM (SELECT author_id, mon, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY mon ORDER BY views DESC) as rnk FROM (SELECT a.author_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', p.view_date) as mon, SUM(p.views_count) as views FROM articles a JOIN page_views p USING (article_id) GROUP BY a.author_id, mon) t) t2 WHERE rnk <= 10 GROUP BY author_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mon) >= 2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE articles (article_id INT, author_id INT); CREATE TABLE page_views (article_id INT, view_date DATE, views_count INT);
